The Democratic Socialists of America are winning elections — and sending waves of joy and terror through the Democratic Party. A little historical context might be useful.

Before you celebrate or panic, there’s a lot to learn here. The Party’s past tells a story that’s getting lost in all the noise. It's both more hopeful, and more cautionary, than either side probably wants to admit.

The “Age of A.I.” could be an age of miracles and wonders — for a few. But it will not uplift the majority of humans by accident. It will require a real commitment to a “new deal” between technology companies and humanity.

Right now, there’s a gap between the abundance of exponential tech and humanity’s ability to keep up. We need to address that gap before we leave people behind.

WHOA!!! Stop whatever you are doing — and read this very carefully. This is NOT just another tech announcement. All these tech companies swear that somehow, some way, their inventions are going to help the disadvantaged.
